study type: In vitro study with human tissue comparison
cohort: The study involved placental tissues from normal and preeclamptic pregnancies, and human HTR-8/SVneo trophoblast cells.
finding: Higher expression of SASH1 was detected in placental tissues from patients with preeclampsia, and SASH1 overexpression inhibited trophoblast cell proliferation, migration, and invasion while inducing apoptosis in vitro.
cross-section timing: At delivery for placental tissue collection
gest_age: Gestational age-matched for placental tissue samples
